content: मय {%a.%} (-यी|{%f.%}) An affix used to indicate ‘made of’, ‘consisting or composed of’, ‘full of’; कनकमय, काष्ठमय, तेजोमय, जलमय <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-यः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon, the architect of the demons. (He built the ‘three cities’ for the demons; <ab>cf.</ab> त्रिपुर. He is also said to have built a splendid hall for the Pāṇḍavas); सानन्दं देवताभिर्मयपुरदहने धूर्जटिः पातु युष्मान् <ls>Ve. 1. 3</ls>. .²2 A horse. .²3 A camel. .²4 A mule. .{@-या@} Medical treatment. .{@-यी@} A mare.
